cues.zhText: 一顿再普通不过的午饭后，你的肚脐周围，突然开始隐隐作痛，甚至泛起恶心，连吐了两次。
cues.enText: After an ordinary lunch, a dull ache starts around your navel, bringing nausea and two bouts of vomiting.

cues.zhText: 早期的疼痛经内脏神经传导，常让人觉得肚脐周围在疼，却很难指出具体位置。
cues.enText: Early pain travels through visceral nerves. It is often felt around the navel, and its exact location is hard to pinpoint.

cues.zhText: 傍晚六点左右，疼痛转移到右下腹。麦氏点是阑尾根部的体表投影。炎症刺激壁腹膜，按压时产生压痛；突然松手，壁腹膜受牵拉，引发反跳痛。两者都是腹膜刺激征，提示炎症已累及腹膜。
cues.enText: Around 6 PM, the pain shifts to the right lower abdomen. McBurney's point marks the surface projection of the appendiceal base. Inflammation irritates the parietal peritoneum, causing tenderness on pressure. Sudden release stretches the parietal peritoneum and elicits rebound tenderness. Both are signs of peritoneal irritation, indicating peritoneal involvement.

cues.zhText: 体温飙升至 39.3℃（正常参考范围 36–37℃），白细胞总数升至 13.0×10⁹/L（正常 4–10×10⁹/L），中性粒细胞数升至 11.3×10⁹/L（正常 2–7×10⁹/L）。
cues.enText: Temperature rose to 39.3°C (reference range 36–37°C). White blood cells rose to 13.0 × 10⁹/L (reference 4–10 × 10⁹/L). Absolute neutrophils rose to 11.3 × 10⁹/L (reference 2–7 × 10⁹/L).

cues.zhText: 到急诊时已过去十小时。那根原本粉白细长的“小香肠”，在炎症中可经历变色：暗红、灰黄，甚至焦黑。
cues.enText: Ten hours have passed by arrival at the emergency department. The slender, pale-pink appendix can change color with inflammation: dark red, grayish yellow, or even black.
